title: Lock-up Expiry／Insider Supply禁售期到期與內部人供給
purpose: Freeze Taiwan lock-up release semantics and document the remaining issuer-level PIT blocker without coercing missing insider-sale evidence into NO_SALE.

officialSources.name: TWSE Listing Review Rules - Innovation Board custody/lock-up
officialSources.finding: Custody/release schedules vary by listing category and qualification; release eligibility is staged and shares under custody cannot be freely transferred.

officialSources.name: TWSE listing/applylisting archive
officialSources.finding: 6921 嘉雨思 is an Innovation Board listing, listed 2025-12-23 after reapplication.

officialSources.name: TWSE OpenAPI catalog
officialSources.finding: Current listed-company feeds are available, but issuer 6921 was not present in the fetched _L snapshots; this is SOURCE_COVERAGE_UNKNOWN, not proof of no transfer.

officialSources.name: MOPS public site
officialSources.finding: Public MOPS exposes director holding and insider-holding-change report families, but direct issuer-level automation could not be completed in this research turn.

secondaryNegativeControl.note: Secondary mirrors showed major-holder quantities broadly unchanged through 2026-08 after the first six-month point. This supports the hypothesis eligible-to-sell != realized-sale, but is not official enough for L3 promotion.

criticalDistinctions: absence from a source lane != NO_SALE
different listing categories can have different staged release fractions
pitRules: Use the listing-rule version effective for the issuer/listing date.
Do not infer exact release fraction until the issuer's applicable listing qualification is pinned.
Preserve custody-release, transfer declaration and realized holding-change clocks separately.
If the official source does not cover the issuer, status remains UNKNOWN.

blockedBy: issuer-specific applicable release schedule not fully pinned
official issuer-level custody release quantity not captured
official post-release transfer/holding realization chain not captured

exactNext: Obtain one issuer-level official chain from listing basis -> custody quantity -> release tranche/date -> MOPS transfer declaration -> subsequent official holdings/untransferred state; include an eligible-but-not-sold negative control before L3.
